### Headline summary
- OpenAI lowered its funding target while Baseten is reportedly raising $2 billion at valuations between $26 billion and $30 billion. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261030/p29#a261030p29), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/openai-lowers-fundraising-target-after-decreasing-possible-valuation))
- Major AI companies have pledged support for a new standard allowing websites to express preferences regarding AI training data scraping. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://openai.com/index/helping-websites-express-ai-training-preferences/), [AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/30/google-anthropic-and-others-to-support-new-ai-crawling-opt-out-standard/))
- S&P Global Ratings downgraded Meta's credit outlook to negative, citing high capital expenditure and negative free cash flow driven by soaring AI spending. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/s-p-lowers-metas-credit-outlook-amid-soaring-ai-spending), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261031/p3#a261031p3))

### AI funding shifts: OpenAI lowers target, Baseten raises $2B
OpenAI lowered its funding target amid an AI selloff, while AI infrastructure firm Baseten is reportedly raising approximately $2 billion in two tranches at valuations between $26 billion and $30 billion. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261030/p29#a261030p29), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/openai-lowers-fundraising-target-after-decreasing-possible-valuation), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261030/p30#a261030p30), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261030/p31#a261030p31))

### Major AI companies support new scraping opt-out standard
Major AI companies have pledged support for a new standard that allows websites to express preferences regarding AI training data scraping. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://openai.com/index/helping-websites-express-ai-training-preferences/), [AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/30/google-anthropic-and-others-to-support-new-ai-crawling-opt-out-standard/), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1023763/openai-google-microsoft-ai-scraping-standard-opt-out), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2303225/google-openai-anthropic-ai-crawling-controls/))

### S&P downgrades Meta's credit outlook due to AI spending
S&P Global Ratings downgraded Meta's credit outlook from stable to negative, citing high capital expenditure and negative free cash flow driven by soaring AI spending. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/s-p-lowers-metas-credit-outlook-amid-soaring-ai-spending), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261031/p3#a261031p3))

### Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
Anthropic is expanding its text watermark to four more Claude models to meet the EU AI Act's December deadline. On the older models Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, developers can bypass the watermark by tweaking a single sampling parameter. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/anthropics-watermark-rollout-leaves-a-loophole-on-two-older-claude-models/))

### Researchers are paid $5K for reporting a bug to OpenAI that would let attackers run code in logged-in sessions of all w…
Swati Khandelwal / The Hacker News : Researchers are paid $5K for reporting a bug to OpenAI that would let attackers run code in logged-in sessions of all who opened the hacker's ChatGPT share link — A malicious ChatGPT share link could run an attacker's code in the logged-in session of anyone who… ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261031/p11#a261031p11))

### Meta builds prototype humanoid robot with Chinese firm Fourier
Meta has built a prototype humanoid robot in collaboration with Chinese robotics company Fourier and is currently developing a second unit, with no plans to sell the devices. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/meta-built-humanoid-prototype-chinese-startup-ramp-robotics-push), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261031/p10#a261031p10))

### VOLTA-Autodoxer malware uses AI to rank victims
Researchers have identified a new infostealer malware named VOLTA-Autodoxer that utilizes AI tools to collect data and rank victims for targeted attacks. ([Artificial Intelligence Latest](https://www.wired.com/story/kernel-panic-volta-autodoxer-ai-infostealer-malware/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/cisco-talos-details-volta-infostealers-llm-victim-ranking-stage/))

### Sam Altman argues for data center RAM usage
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated that supply-constrained DRAM is better utilized in data centers than in personal computers, where it is often underused. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261031/p5#a261031p5), [TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114398-sam-altman-terrible-ram-sit-inside-pcs-instead.html))
